ground_source_contract.source_call: src/root/m0250.c f_0250_0256 calls o00_31AD_18BA(*fd_50F6_37DE, 0xa000, 0x100) for the selected kind-9 ground object 10-set
ground_source_contract.layout: Each tile is 16 rows; each row has four interleaved two-byte EGA planes at source offsets 0,2,4,6; source row stride 8; source tile stride 0x80 (128 bytes). The 0x100 argument is a count of tiles.

life_source_contract.layout: _2B1A reads 16 rows of a two-byte mask followed by four two-byte color planes (160 bytes/frame), combines each color plane as base XOR ((overlay XOR base) AND mask), and writes 4 words per row into g_3D20. _2FDA presents that buffer through _0CF9 with width and height 16.
life_source_contract.resource_groups: source LoadTiles maps IDs 15..17 as surface and 18..20 as nest; the portable map chooses that group by MapPlane and uses three 0x5000-byte chunks, 128 frames per chunk.
life_source_contract.frame_normalization: f_0250_0721/f_0250_0915 subtract 0x100, 0x200, or 0x280 by source frame range before indexing the selected EMS group.

differential.life_blitter_scope: 140 original _2B1A normalized selected-plane readback cases (128 randomized plus first/last actual frames in resources 15..20), 0 byte mismatches in all 128 g_3D20 output bytes; no physical EGA read-map, atlas placement, _2FDA clipping or screen-output equality claim.

negative_review_preserved.note: This earlier review rejected the 16x20 inference from 0xA0/resource size. It remains unchanged; current positive assembly anchors establish 16x16 and 0x80 ground tile stride independently.
